title: Treasure Search Optimization
summary: We introduce Treasure Search Optimization (TSO), an interacting particle method for global optimization. Most swarm methods balance exploration and exploitation within a single population, and typically switch between the two by degenerating the noise, annealing a temperature, or tuning a parameter. TSO instead splits these tasks across two kinds of agents. A swarm of explorers stays in exploration mode and a single treasure hunter performs exploitation.
